diagnosis: The checks C6 passed because the lone decision-maker set the 'repository_context_uploads_enabled' to false, which aligns with the default behavior in the absence of any conflicting information. This is evident in all four rollouts where the decision-maker chose to disable repository-context uploads, even though PF4, which flips C6, was never accessible to them.

C6.why: The threat-model finding changes repository-context uploads from the ordinary enabled beta behavior to disabled and requires a security-followup commitment that must be cited as the reason.
